$comment: A required certification that is a product certification (QuickBooks ProAdvisor), two required taxonomy products, and one required product outside the taxonomy (Dext) that must land in other_required_software verbatim rather than be dropped. Xero, Toast and Square are bonuses. Title drops the location and hours qualifiers. "roughly 15 to 20 hours a week" is in the opening paragraph, not a bullet: hours_per_week is the lower figure, 15. "at least two mornings a week during Pacific time" gives no number of hours of overlap, so min_overlap_hours is null.

requirements.title: Part-Time Bookkeeper
must_haves: At least 3 years of bookkeeping for restaurants or other hospitality businesses
Hands-on experience with Gusto payroll, including tip reporting
Dext (formerly Receipt Bank) for receipt capture and bill entry
Able to work at least two mornings a week during Pacific time
nice_to_haves: Experience with Toast or Square POS reconciliations
Xero experience (one of our entities may move to it)
Comfortable talking to chefs and managers about invoices
